note: **1 and 3 Holles Crescent, schedules 262 and 260 of the 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB.** The book is taken from the walk - 263 is 3 Park Drive and 264 is 1 Park Drive, both RMGB - and no other book uses either number. Both houses had nothing at all for 1939 before this.
source: 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB, The National Archives RG101/6178A
